fr_html: Cet amendement est rejeté, mais, en s'en inspirant, le PRESIDENT propose l'insertion après le mot „personnes“ des mots „corps ou organes“.
en_html: This amendment was rejected, but, borrowing an idea contained in it, the PRESIDENT proposed that the words: “bodies or organisations” should be inserted after the word “individuals”.
